WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    f.orderslink,
    o.dealedge,
    AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) as net_fee,
    COUNT(*) as rec_count
  FROM fees f
  JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.dealedge
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT
    dealedge,
    AVG(net_fee) as avg_net_fee
  FROM step1
  GROUP BY dealedge
)
SELECT
  s1.orderslink,
  s1.dealedge,
  s1.net_fee,
  s1.rec_count,
  s1.net_fee - s2.avg_net_fee as margin
FROM step1 s1
JOIN step2 s2 ON s1.dealedge = s2.dealedge
WHERE s1.net_fee > s2.avg_net_fee
ORDER BY margin DESC
LIMIT 10
